These tiny synthetic test faces are original Ofdrw.Net MIT test symbols, derived
from the existing `narrow.ttf` generated by `scripts/generate-font-test-fixtures.py`.
They are not reading fonts. `scripts/generate-skia-style-fixtures.py` deterministically
changes weight/style tables and actual rectangle outlines: SemiBold/Bold widen
ink; Oblique/Italic shear outlines. head/OS2 bits agree in supported fixtures;
`mismatch`, `missing-os2` and `short-os2` are explicit rejection fixtures. No fontTools runtime
dependency or font resolver/parser service is added.
